analysis.failureMechanism: Lock queue starvation on PostgreSQL rooms table leading to query cancellation (SQLSTATE 57014) on PID 13795 at 17:33:06.563Z, subsequent LiveKit participant eviction at 17:33:06.624Z, and receiver test timeout at 45000ms.

defensibleReductions.rationale: CallsService.join never mutates rooms table. Using FOR SHARE prevents exclusive lock queue starvation against concurrent gateway and API lease readers while maintaining row integrity against deletions. call_groups and call_members remain locked FOR UPDATE.

defensibleReductions.change: Move config.client.createRoom outside the database transaction to post-commit
defensibleReductions.rationale: Eliminates network HTTP Twirp RPC latency (50-350ms) from the database row lock window. LiveKit room creation is idempotent.

defensibleReductions.change: Remove redundant duplicate call to this.actor(db, user, session)
defensibleReductions.rationale: Actor authorization (session, ban, onboarding) is already strictly verified with row lock in the same transaction at line 45. Removing duplicate saves 3 database queries under lock.

changes: Add POST /api/v1/calls/:id/join route detection in instrumentHttpTimingMiddleware

scenarios.name: Concurrent gateway lease under in-flight join
scenarios.description: Continuously executes SELECT id FROM rooms WHERE id=$1 FOR SHARE every 100ms with statement_timeout=3000ms while concurrent CallsService.join executes.
scenarios.expected: All lease queries succeed with duration < 200ms; zero 57014 cancellations.

scenarios.name: Fail-closed security invariants
scenarios.description: Validates that banned user, expired session, unauthorized room member, and 11th participant strictly fail closed.
scenarios.expected: Proper ErrorCode exceptions thrown; no unauthorized row mutations.
